narrative.intro: Orano Federal Services obligated $900M in FY2026 to date. Orano Federal Services has three awards with an average award size of $300M, and obligations are up 179824.9% year over year. Orano Federal Services shows a sharp increase from earlier fiscal years: FY21 obligations were $251K, FY22 obligations were $1.5M, FY23 obligations were $655K, and FY25 obligations were $500K. Orano Federal Services is concentrated in one primary NAICS market, Other Basic Inorganic Chemical Manufacturing, which accounts for $900M in obligations. Orano Federal Services also appears in All Other Professional, Scientific, and Technical Services. The current-year totals are partial and represent fiscal year to date obligations, while the largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables list total contract values rather than current-year obligations.
